mentions.name: Narro
mentions.description: A user-curated social media app where users enter the profiles they want to follow from Instagram, TikTok, X, and other platforms, and the app shows only posts from those selected profiles. There is no algorithm, ads, or infinite scroll — once all new posts have been seen, the feed ends, providing a natural stopping point for scrolling.
mentions.problem: Algorithmic feeds, ads, and infinite scroll make social media scrolling endless; this app addresses that by providing a natural stopping point for scrolling.

mentions.name: Narro
mentions.description: A user-curated social media app that aggregates posts from the profiles a user follows on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, and LinkedIn and displays them in chronological order with no algorithm, no ads, and no tracking. Its feed is finite by design: users see what the people they follow actually posted, reach the end, and are done, rather than encountering infinite scroll, which creates a different usage habit. Users curate their own feed and can keep separate feeds for separate interests.
mentions.problem: Every mainstream social app is engineered with infinite scroll and algorithmic feeds.
mentions.source_excerpt: Narro, it's a user-curated social media app. You add the profiles you follow on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, and LinkedIn, and Narro shows their posts in chronological order, with no algorithm, no ads, and no tracking.
